login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the address and password of your mailbox.
login.headline:
Mail
that belongs to you
login.tagline: Your messages stay with you, not in someone else's cloud. No ads, no prying eyes.
login.passwordNote: Your password is not saved in the browser.

errors.invalid_credentials: Wrong address or password. Check them and try again.
errors.mail_unavailable: Mail is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.validation_failed: Check that the address and password are complete and have no stray characters.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Could not sign in. Try again.

toast.undoFailed: Could not put the message back. Look for it in the folder it went to.

errors.mail_unavailable: Mail is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.mail_busy: Mail is very busy right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.session_revoked: Your mailbox password has changed or access was closed. Sign in again.
errors.uid_validity_changed: The folder changed on the mail side. The list was refreshed; open the message again.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.not_found: This message or folder is gone: it may have been deleted or moved. Refresh the list.
errors.payload_too_large: This message is too large to be shown here.
errors.no_target_folder: This mailbox has no suitable folder (archive, spam or trash). Create one and try again.

selection.limit: You can select at most {{max}} messages at a time.

list.empty: It is empty here. Try another filter.
list.offline: No connection. You see what was already loaded; the list will refresh when the connection is back.

reader.suspicious: This looks like fraud: the sender pretends to be a different organization. Do not follow links and do not enter a password.
reader.imagesBlocked: External images are hidden so that the sender cannot tell when you opened the message.
reader.imagesAlwaysOffer: The sender is verified. Show their images right away, without asking?
reader.imagesAlways: Images from {{address}} are shown right away.
reader.imagesAlwaysFailed: Could not save your choice. Please try again.
reader.imagesSomeMissing: Some images could not be loaded.
reader.flagFailed: Could not save the mark. Check your connection and try again.
reader.truncated: This message is very long: only the beginning is shown.
